prompt: Can you add one minute to the time of the title track from the album released by Ray Charles in the year before Phil Quartararo took over as president of its record label?
answer:
Phil Quartararo became president of Warner Bros. Records in 1997. The preceding year, Ray Charles released *Strong Love Affair* (1996), whose title track runs about **4:26**.

Adding one minute gives **5:26**.
